description: This PHP class file defines the QuestionOptions model, representing question options in a questionnaire within the Goteo application. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, and validating question options, along with associated properties and database interactions.

classes.name: QuestionOptions
classes.description: Model class representing options for questions in a questionnaire, with capabilities for database persistence, validation, and retrieval.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the language-specific fields for this model, in this case, 'option'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the current question option to the database, handling errors.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of question options from the database based on filters, pagination, and language.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the model instance; currently always returns true.
